title: lipovsek-lab/qc-pipeline pipeline parameters
description: QC pipeline for mouse utricle single-cell data: cell calling, doublet detection, minimal filtering, dimensionality reduction, clustering and outlier removal.

raw_adata.description: Absolute path to the raw AnnData (.h5ad) file. Should contain all cells and all genes if running CellBender.

batch.description: Name of the batch ID column in adata.obs.

celltype_csv.description: CSV file used for simple marker-based cell typing.

metadata.description: obs column used for QC/embedding plot colouring during dimensionality reduction.

skip_cellbender.description: Skip CellBender ambient-RNA/cell-calling correction (set false only when raw_adata contains all droplets, not just called cells).

cellbender_csv.description: Optional CSV with per-batch CellBender settings (columns: batch, total_droplets_included, expected_cells). Leave unset to let CellBender estimate all values automatically.

join_csv.description: Optional CSV to join adatas after CellBender, as an alternative entry point to the workflow.

adata.description: AnnData (.h5ad) produced by a prior qc_pipeline run, to filter outliers from.

clusters.description: obs column holding cluster labels used for outlier detection.

descriptor.description: Short label used in output file names for this run (e.g. 'alldata', 'postnatal').

csv_paths.description: Glob of prior report_stats CSVs to fold into the filtering summary plot.

batch_csv_paths.description: Optional glob of prior per-batch report_stats CSVs to fold into the filtering summary plot.

doublets.description: obs column holding doublet calls used for outlier detection.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.
